rule_class: Enumerate full diagonal sets of region cells and contiguous diagonal runs. For each mode consider five visible tie criteria:none,centre offset,corner distance,and both priority orders. Retain every tied prediction. A rule must uniquely reproduce each demonstration; all surviving query predictions must agree. No scan-order fallback or preferred full-line rule.
limitations: Native random sampler requires a unique full-line maximum and connected zero region. Explicit fixtures can contain ties. This ten-rule hypothesis class handles the documented central-line fixture tie but does not claim arbitrary hidden constructor scan-order ties are inferable; unresolved ties reject. Both broken and unbroken winning lines retained.
